title: Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride in Minneapolis
includes: Fresh hand-made German pretzel for every guest
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: This is a bring-your-own beer and wine ride. We'll have ice on board.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Minneapolis from a fresh perspective on the Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride, a guided cycling route through one of the city's most creative districts. Pedal along scenic river routes while admiring public art installations, historic architecture, and vibrant urban murals. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, this tour offers an engaging way to explore local culture and waterfront views at an easy, enjoyable pace. Stops include iconic local restaurants serving food and beverages and art stops.
